summary: Returns a string-keyed linked list search result for the "SeasonRaces" section using either a provided search key or a key computed from the current scene array slot; gated by a name lookup check via AudioChannelStop on the "SeasonRaces" token. Returns 0 when the gate fails or no scene array is available.

operations.description: Gate: call AudioChannelStop with the "SeasonRaces" name token (aSeasonraces); if it returns 0 the function returns 0 without searching.
If the a1 parameter is non-zero, use it directly as the search key.
Call StringKeyedLinkedListSearch(a1) and return its result.
When a1 is zero, proceed only if dword_8AC490 (scene array base) is non-zero.
Compute the scene-section search key as dword_8AC490 + 396 * dword_8AC48C + 260 (scene array base plus the current scene index scaled by 396 plus 260).
Call StringKeyedLinkedListSearch with the computed scene-section search key and return its result.
Return 0 when the AudioChannelStop gate fails or when no scene array is available.
